recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中有多顆漿細胞（偏心核、深藍胞質、核旁淡區），其中一顆大型漿細胞胞質內有淡藍色、邊界清楚的圓球狀包涵體（Russell body），位於核上方，提示漿細胞腫瘤中的免疫球蛋白堆積。
features: Increased plasma cells with eccentric nuclei, clock-face chromatin and deeply basophilic cytoplasm with perinuclear hof
Large atypical plasma cell containing a sharply defined round pale blue-gray globular inclusion (Russell body)
Some plasma cells enlarged with prominent nucleoli and irregular cytoplasmic outlines
Background of residual myeloid precursors, segmented neutrophils and erythroid precursors
Scattered red cells with a hemodiluted, crowded aspirate background
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows increased plasma cells, including mature forms with eccentric nuclei, coarse chromatin and deeply basophilic cytoplasm with perinuclear hof, as well as enlarged atypical forms with nucleoli. One large plasma cell contains a round, homogeneous, pale blue-gray cytoplasmic inclusion consistent with a Russell body. Residual granulocytic and erythroid precursors are present. Findings are consistent with a plasma cell neoplasm with Russell body formation; plasma cell percentage, clonality studies and serum/urine protein electrophoresis are required for classification as plasma cell myeloma.

ddx.vs: Reactive plasma cells are mature, lack nucleoli and atypia, usually constitute under 10% of cells and are polytypic, although Russell bodies themselves can occur in reactive states.
Mott cells contain multiple smaller Russell bodies filling the cytoplasm like a bunch of grapes, whereas this cell has a single large globule.
Macrophages contain phagocytosed red cells or nuclear debris with abundant pale cytoplasm and a central nucleus, not a homogeneous immunoglobulin globule in a basophilic plasma cell.
